title: VitaFormer: bright-field organoid segmentation (Windows desktop application) v1.1.0
description: Windows desktop application for segmenting bright-field organoid images into background, Alive, Dead and Bubble with the frozen VitaFormer model (training seed 42), with image-level readouts and optional normalisation to control images. The Dead class was not externally validated; see docs/LIMITATIONS.md.
